newsitem.title: USA: OptiMark Tech to unveil securities trading system.
newsitem.headline: OptiMark Tech to unveil securities trading system.

text.p: OptiMark Technologies Inc said it will unveil on Tuesday a new supercomputer-based securities order matching system and said two U.S. exchanges have already committed to implementing the system.

OptiMark said the system was designed in conjunction with strategic partners International Business Machines Corp and Dow Jones & Co Inc and offers an optimized, anonymous order matching system for use by retail brokers and other market participants.
The Pacific Stock Exchange and the Chicago Board Options Exchange have committed to being the first exchanges to implement the system, an OptiMark spokeswoman said.
Executives from IBM, Dow Jones, the Pacific Stock and Chicago Board Options Exchanges and State Street Boston Corp are slated to appear at the press conference.
